name: 33993 · Cape Coral, FL
findings: ZIP 33993 (Cape Coral) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33993 (Cape Coral) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
70% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
